description: This file defines classes related to security and file scanning within the SuiteCRM project. It includes classes for scanning directories, analyzing file contents for includes and require statements, and managing multiple scanner instances.
external_files: php's standard functions like fopen, fwrite, fclose, file_get_contents

classes.name: SugarSecure
classes.description: Provides methods for displaying, saving, and scanning directory contents for PHP files.

classes.name: ScanFileIncludes
classes.description: Extends SugarSecure; specializes in scanning file contents for include and require statements.

classes.name: SugarSecureManager
classes.description: Manages multiple scanner instances, handling their registration, execution, and result display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the results stored in the object as an HTML table.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for PHP files.

methods.name: scanContents
methods.description: Analyzes file contents for specific include/require calls.

methods.name: registerScan
methods.description: Registers a scanner class with the manager.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Triggers all registered scanners to perform their scans.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the results from all registered scanners.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves aggregate scan results to a timestamped file.
